title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Resumption Deposit: Amount
content:
**Finance schedule, resumption deposits — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** On an agreement that records a conversion to another payer source and is active again:

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| Resumption deposit | The resumption deposit days times the resumption per-day amount, plus the resumption recurring-service allowance and the resumption personal-item allowance, less the deposit balance recorded on the agreement, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure; paid into the agreement's security deposit by the resident or representative; where it is zero nothing is paid |
| Purpose of the two allowances | They secure one month of the ancillary charges the center bills the resident in arrears on the resident's ancillary account (**Ancillary and Optional Services Billing**) |
| Resumption per-day amount | The daily rate of the resumption deposit tier under the resumption deposit schedule less the resumption insurer share, never below zero, the share being taken off the rate before the rate is multiplied by the resumption deposit days |
| "Within the last given number of months" | Fewer than that many whole calendar months separate the entry's date from the day the resumption deposit is worked out |
| Resumption deposit days | The security deposit days of the agreement's tier (the tier's deposit terms) |
| Resumption deposit tier | The tier of the agreement's admission-month charge |
| Resumption deposit schedule | The one in effect on the agreement's admission date: the current private pay schedule for an admission on or after its effective date, 1 July 2026, and the preceding schedule otherwise |
| Resumption insurer share | Nothing |
| Resumption recurring-service allowance | One month of every recurring service billed to the resident within the last twelve months, at the price schedule's monthly charge for that service on the resident's Ancillary and Optional Services Billing account |
| Resumption personal-item allowance | Nothing |

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Hypothetical worked example.** An admission to the Private Suite with Sitting Area before 1 July 2026, so the rate is the preceding 497.00; deposit days 30; insurer share nothing; cable television billed within the last twelve months, at 42.00 a month; personal items nothing; deposit held 14,910.00, not disposed of when private billing resumed. 30 times 497.00 is 14,910.00; plus 42.00, less 14,910.00, is 42.00.
